parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are a sales call analyst. Analyze the following sales call transcript and return a JSON object with these fields:

- sentiment: overall sentiment (positive, neutral, negative)
- key_topics: array of up to 5 main topics discussed
- objections: array of objects with {objection, response, resolved: boolean} for each objection raised by the prospect
- action_items: array of strings for follow-up actions
- buying_signals: array of strings indicating purchase intent
- risk_factors: array of strings indicating deal risks
- next_steps: string summarizing agreed next steps
- deal_stage_suggestion: string (discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, closed_won, closed_lost)
- key_turning_point: string describing the most pivotal moment in the conversation
- competitor_mentions: array of competitor names mentioned
- pain_points: array of prospect pain points identified
- confidence_score: number 0-100 indicating likelihood of deal closing

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown or explanation.

Call Title: {{ $json.title }}
Prospect: {{ $json.prospect_name }} ({{ $json.company }})

Transcript:
{{ $json.transcript_text }}"
    }
  ]
}

={
  "call_id": "{{ $json.call_id }}",
  "sentiment": "{{ $json.sentiment }}",
  "key_topics": {{ JSON.stringify($json.key_topics) }},
  "objections": {{ JSON.stringify($json.objections) }},
  "action_items": {{ JSON.stringify($json.action_items) }},
  "buying_signals": {{ JSON.stringify($json.buying_signals) }},
  "risk_factors": {{ JSON.stringify($json.risk_factors) }},
  "next_steps": {{ JSON.stringify($json.next_steps) }},
  "deal_stage_suggestion": "{{ $json.deal_stage_suggestion }}",
  "key_turning_point": {{ JSON.stringify($json.key_turning_point) }},
  "competitor_mentions": {{ JSON.stringify($json.competitor_mentions) }},
  "pain_points": {{ JSON.stringify($json.pain_points) }},
  "confidence_score": {{ $json.confidence_score }}
}
